A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
MEE is a powerful tool for distinguishing strains of Campylobacter, but serotyping remains the most practical and useful method.
the best method to distinguish epidemic-related strains of Campylobacter is ribotyping.
the methods which correctly identified all strains of the epidemics were: serotyping, ribotyping, MEE and restriction endonucleases.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there are no simple, easy, and inexpensive methods that can be used in the clinical or public health laboratory to distinguish strains that are epidemiologically associated.
the most effective way to identify strains in an epidemic setting is to compare the isolates to a collection of reference isolates from the same species, serotype and geographic region.

the choice of method should be based on the purpose of the study, the number of strains to be compared, the level of genetic resolution needed, the time and money available, and the expertise of the laboratory personnel.
